outcome.Summary: Added tags and due dates to tasker: model.Task gained `Tags []string` and `Due *time.Time` (both omitempty) with normalisation in Validate (trim/lower/de-dupe/sort, regex `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` via new exported `model.NormalizeTags`/`ErrBadTag`); store.Version bumped to 2 (v1 files still load, saves always v2); `add`/`edit` accept `--tag`/`--untag`/`--due`/`--due none` with usage errors (exit 2) on bad values; `list` supports repeatable `--tag` (ALL must match), `--overdue` (due strictly before today UTC, open tasks only) and `--sort due` (no due last, ties by ID); FormatTask appends ` (due YYYY-MM-DD)` then `[tag1,tag2]`; new `tags` command prints tag counts for open tasks sorted by tag; usage message and README updated. Added tests in model, store, query and cli covering normalisation, v1→v2 migration, filtering/sorting, all CLI flags, exit codes and the format example; verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./...` and an end-to-end binary smoke test.
